experiments.name: Phase 2 Core Point Benchmark (2016-2022 Rolling Folds)
experiments.rationale: OOF predictions for 5 core models across folds 1-4 were verified newly computed in R13 forensic audit; hashes verified in R20 freeze audit. Lineage is clean and uncorrupted.

experiments.name: Phase 3 Core Probabilistic Benchmark (P1-P5 Rolling Folds)
experiments.rationale: OOF predictions for P1-P5 were verified computed in R13 and capability-separated in R19. No unsupported continuous metrics are evaluated for P5.

experiments.name: Phase 5 Paired Statistical Comparison Across All Model Pairs
experiments.rationale: Repaired in R18 with Holm-Bonferroni step-down FWER control and day-cluster bootstrap on FL_DATE. All 48 comparison families verified; zero None in adjusted_p for valid hypothesis tests.

experiments.name: Phase 7 Academic Model Selection on 2023 Development Set
experiments.rationale: R10 forensic audit established that R10 reused stale selection artifacts. Furthermore, R19/R20 reconciled selection protocol to mandate 3 distinct operational roles (Role A Point, Role B Probabilistic Forecast, Role C Downstream Candidates) rather than claiming a single overall champion.

experiments.name: Phase 8 Downstream Gate Assignment Model Comparison on 2023 Scenarios
experiments.rationale: R10 reused stale downstream artifacts. R14/R17 identified downstream semantics issues: scalar median/mean reduction without uncertainty distributions, conflated REMOTE vs UNASSIGNED vs CONTACT gates, and missing CP-SAT gap tracking. Must run locked SCALAR_FORECAST_IMPACT pipeline across 7 candidates x 4 scenarios x 3 solvers = 84 runs.

experiments.name: Phase 9 Fair Monte Carlo Model Comparison and Convergence on 2023
experiments.rationale: R10 reused stale MC artifacts. Historical claims of 82.4% variance reduction and N=500 optimality were unsubstantiated or based on truncated N. Must evaluate exact N in (100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500) under Common Random Numbers (CRN), track O(1/sqrt(N)) SE, and record reduction as NOT_ESTABLISHED.

experiments.name: Phase 6 Temporal Stability Evaluation (2016-2022 Rolling Folds)
experiments.rationale: Derived directly from verified fold 1-4 OOF predictions. Bitwise hashes verified in R20 freeze manifest.

experiments.name: Phase 11 Locked 2024 Post-Holdout Evaluation
experiments.rationale: Strictly forbidden during development evidence rebuild. Sealed under temporal governance until R23.

experiments.name: P5 Quantile Regression Continuous Metrics (NLL, PIT, Sampling)
experiments.rationale: P5 quantile regression does not construct a valid continuous density or random sampler. Evaluation of continuous NLL, PIT, or naive sampling is mathematically unsupported.

experiments.name: Single Overall Champion Claim (Student-T + Copula)
experiments.rationale: Decoupled in R19/R20. Forecast excellence and downstream utility are separate operational layers. Replaced with 3 distinct operational roles.

experiments.name: Real-World Airfield Gate Improvement and Real Delay Reduction Claims
experiments.rationale: BTS Form 41 data contains zero gate numbers. All gate assignments and conflicts are evaluated strictly within a synthetic turn simulation environment.
